critical_exam_policy_note: EA is route-specific: MBA rejects EA in lieu of GMAT/GRE; Sloan Fellows expressly accepts GMAT/GRE/EA optional and accepts expired scores for 2026-27; EMBA requires neither GMAT nor EA and overview says may submit those two, while GRE acceptance/submission is not established. Never treat EA globally as Sloan-wide evidence.
general_mit_policy_note: MIT OGE says each department controls test requirements and graduate applications use a home department; interdisciplinary programs generally require a home department. General 2026-27 graduate tuition is $33,360 per regular term, but Sloan and other non-standard programs differ. Do not apply department rules/costs to an internal degree or dual pathway without confirmation.
